title.narrative: Improved aquaculture brood stock production technologies developed

description.narrative: Improved aquaculture brood stock production technologies developed

comment.narrative: 2 new generations of improved reference brood stock nile tilapia and african catfish will be multiplied maintained and distributed to hatcheries

The nutritional profiling was completed in the last reporting period which informed the test feed formulations. Twenty 20 formulationshave been generated for testing for two developmental stages thus juvenile and grow outs. Five test diets for each of the developmentalstages have been formulated. Onstation feeding experiments commenced during the period. These are aimed at assessing and establishing the performance of the generated feed formulations on the fish growth.
